Subject: Next steps - schedule technical deep dive / demo

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning — great to hear more about Acme Analytics’ use cases around real-time summarization and customer-facing search. Quick recap from our side:

- Primary goal: reduce query latency for user-facing search while keeping inference cost predictable.
- Key constraints: PCI-scope data segmentation, single-region deployment in us-west, and a sub-100ms target for conversational snippets.

Next recommended step: a technical deep dive/demo with one of our inference engineers to walk through a sample workload, expected latency/cost tradeoffs, and deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).

Would any of these slots work for your team next week (US Pacific times):
- Tue 2026-03-10 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 2026-03-11 14:00–15:00 PT
- Thu 2026-03-12 09:00–10:00 PT

Please share who from your team will join (SE/Infra/PM), and if you prefer Zoom or Google Meet. I’ve attached a short one-pager and a proposed agenda for the deep dive.

Attachments: redwood-product-one-pager.pdf

Thanks — I’ll coordinate calendar invites once we lock a time.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0127

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform
